rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies an expanded Day 5 blastocyst with thinned zona, visible ICM, and cohesive TE consistent with 3AA; minor overinterpretation of subtle irregularity and absence of image-limited caution prevents a perfect score.

Integrates age, BMI, PCOS diagnosis, ovarian reserve markers, prior IVF failures, sperm quality, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality well, though it somewhat overstates DOR/poor responder conclusions from limited data.

Overall logic is structured and the implantation estimate is tied to embryo quality and prior failures, but there are notable leaps and inconsistencies, especially inferring poor responder/DOR and suggesting implantation issues without adequate support.

Morphology discussion is broadly aligned, but recommendations such as NK/HLA immune workup and IVIG/immunology framing are not guideline-supported routine IVF practice; PGT-A discussion is somewhat overstated as well.

Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer, luteal support, protocol review, lifestyle optimization, and future-cycle considerations, though some suggestions are not evidence-based enough to merit the highest score.
